lines.text: The disciples ask who is greatest, and Jesus has a child stand among them and says the humble one is greatest.
Jesus says anyone who makes a little one who believes in Him stumble would be better drowned with a millstone.
If a brother sins against you, confront him privately, then take one or two others, then tell it to the priests.
Jesus says if two of you agree about anything you ask, it will be done by the angels in heaven.
